authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: The company's latest quarterly report states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. It reported cash and cash equivalents of $88.7 million at quarter end. The prior annual report carried the same doubt.
After the quarter end, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million from common stock sales under its at-the-market equity offering facility.
Kodiak announced that the primary endpoints were met for both Zenkuda and tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) in the Phase 3 DAYBREAK wet AMD study.
no_value_reason: no valuation route yet for a company with no operating profit in 4 of its last 4 fiscal years

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 7 and Item 1A passages
business_model.claim: Kodiak sells nothing today. It is a pre-commercial company with no approved product and no revenue, so it has no customers or revenue drivers yet.
quotes: We do not have any products approved for sale and have not generated any product revenue since inception.

business_model.basis: stated for the pipeline and goal; the customer is inferred from the retina-specialist references
business_model.claim: The business is a retina-focused pipeline of three late-stage candidates: Zenkuda (tarcocimab), tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) and KSI-101. They are intravitreal biologics meant to treat retinal vascular and inflammatory diseases. The evidence does not name the eventual buyers. Mentions of retina specialists' practice suggest physicians would administer the drugs, but that is inferred.
quotes: Our goal is to prevent and treat the major causes of blindness by developing and commercializing next-generation therapeutics to address multiple unmet needs on the spectrum of retinal diseases.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A, the earnings release and the 10-K risk factors
business_model.claim: Near-term value events are regulatory and clinical. A three-indication BLA for Zenkuda is planned for the fourth quarter. The company reports that the DAYBREAK primary endpoints were met, and first KSI-101 Phase 3 topline data are expected in December.
quotes: We are planning to submit a three-indication (wet AMD, DR, and RVO) biologics license application (“BLA”) for Zenkuda in the fourth quarter of 2026.

business_model.basis: stated in the income statement and the earnings release
business_model.claim: Costs are driven mainly by research and development. For the nine months, R&D was 162,934 (table in thousands of dollars) against G&A of 30,779 and total operating expenses of 193,713. Management attributes the third-quarter R&D increase to clinical and manufacturing activity.
quotes: The increase in R&D expenses in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by increased clinical activities related to our active PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO studies and increased manufacturing activities to support our Phase 3 programs.

business_model.basis: stated in the cash flow statement and balance sheet
business_model.claim: The company has no operating inflow, so its cash declines. Net cash used in operating activities for the nine months was (130,112) (table in thousands of dollars), and cash and cash equivalents fell from 209,862 at year-end to 88,678.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A and the earnings release
business_model.claim: The company funds itself through capital markets rather than sales. It has used the issuance of common stock and the sale of future royalties, and it raised net proceeds of $69 million from at-the-market sales of stock after quarter-end.
quotes: We have funded our operations primarily through the issuance of common stock and the sale of future royalties.
Subsequent to September 30, 2026 , Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million from sales of common stock under its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering facility.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q going-concern passages and the earnings release
business_model.claim: The financing need is acute. Management states substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern, while also saying current cash should support operations into 2027. Cash was $88.7 million at September 30.
quotes: As a result, there is substantial doubt regarding the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K business section; the cost effect is inferred from the earnings release
business_model.claim: The company has built its own commercial-scale manufacturing capability, a fixed-cost investment ahead of any sales. It is a dedicated drug substance facility made in collaboration with Lonza.
quotes: Ursus, our dedicated commercial-scale drug substance manufacturing facility that was custom-designed and built in collaboration with Lonza

competitive_position.claim: Kodiak is a precommercial retina company with a late-stage pipeline of Zenkuda, tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) and KSI-101. It has no approved products and no revenue, so its position rests on pipeline results, not on market share.
quotes: We are developing a portfolio of three late-stage clinical programs, two of which are derived from our ABC platform and one which is platform-independent.
We commenced operations in June 2009, have no products approved for commercial sale and have not generated any revenue.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the company release and 8-K; the characterization is management's.
competitive_position.claim: Zenkuda's strongest recent evidence is the Phase 3 DAYBREAK wet AMD study. It met its primary endpoint with p-value 0.0007, and 54% of patients were on 6-month dosing. The company calls this a first-line benchmark.
quotes: Zenkuda met the primary endpoint (p-value of 0.0007) demonstrating meaningful vision gains as well as rapid and sustained retinal drying with the majority of patients (54%) on 6-month dosing, establishing a first-line benchmark in wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD).

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-Q by the company.
competitive_position.claim: The platform's differentiation is durability: Zenkuda has a longer mean ocular half-life than approved anti-VEGF therapies, measured at 20 days, and is designed to keep drug levels in the eye longer.
quotes: Zenkuda has a mean ocular half-life in humans of 20 days, approximately three times longer than approved anti-VEGF therapies and is designed to maintain potent and effective drug levels in ocular tissues for longer.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 8-K release and the 10-K risk factors.
competitive_position.claim: Safety in DAYBREAK was reported as favorable. Zenkuda had a 0% intraocular inflammation rate and a 0.5% cataract rate versus 0.9% for aflibercept. Earlier cataract findings in other trials remain a named risk.
quotes: Zenkuda demonstrated favorable safety and was well tolerated in the study with a 0% intraocular inflammation rate and a 0.5% cataract adverse event rate (vs 0.9% with aflibercept comparator).

For example, in the tarcocimab arms of our completed GLEAM and GLIMMER clinical trials, we observed an unexpected increase in cataracts, which we believe may have contributed meaningfully to the failure of each study to meet its primary efficacy endpoint.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the company release; the counter is from the same release.
competitive_position.claim: The second asset, tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501), met its vision primary endpoint (p-value 0.0036) and anatomical key secondary endpoint (p-value <0.0001) in DAYBREAK. It is now in a Phase 3 DME study, ALTO, designed to test superiority over aflibercept.
quotes: Tabirafusp-ted met the vision primary endpoint (p-value of 0.0036) and anatomical key secondary endpoint (p-value of <0.0001).

competitive_position.basis: Stated by the company; the market-gap statement is management's view.
competitive_position.claim: KSI-101 targets macular edema secondary to inflammation (MESI), which the company describes as having no available intravitreal biologic therapy. The first Phase 3 readout is expected in December.
quotes: Currently there are no available intravitreal biologic therapies addressing the spectrum of MESI diseases.
Looking ahead, we expect to announce the first Phase 3 KSI-101 results in December and, if successful, plan to file a BLA for KSI-101 in the second quarter of 2027.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-Q and its risk factors.
competitive_position.claim: The company plans a multi-indication BLA for Zenkuda (wet AMD, DR, RVO) in the fourth quarter, but it has never submitted a BLA. The submission could be delayed, and the FDA may not accept the AI-guided dosing in the label.
quotes: We are planning to submit a three-indication (wet AMD, DR, and RVO) biologics license application (“BLA”) for Zenkuda in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We have never submitted a BLA
FDA may not approve a label for a particular dosing frequency, even if we believe the data demonstrate support for that dosing.

competitive_position.basis: Stated by the company; the advantage is management's characterization.
competitive_position.claim: Kodiak has built dedicated commercial-scale manufacturing with Lonza (the URSUS facility) and keeps all global rights to its candidates, which it presents as supporting potential launch readiness and flexibility.
quotes: URSUS is a custom-designed premium commercial manufacturing facility dedicated to the large scale manufacture of Kodiak’s ABC medicines, built in collaboration with Lonza, a leading drug contract manufacturing firm.
To date, we have retained all global rights to make, use and sell our product candidates, which we believe preserves future value and allows for agile decision-making.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the financial statements, the 10-Q going-concern note and the earnings release.
competitive_position.claim: The main threat the evidence names is funding. Cash fell to 88,678 (table in thousands) at Sep. 30, 2026 from 209,862 at Dec. 31, 2025, and nine-month operating cash use was 130,112. The filing says there is substantial doubt about going concern. After quarter-end the company raised $69 million net through its ATM facility.
quotes: Our financial condition raises substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.
Subsequent to September 30, 2026, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million through sales of common stock under its ATM equity offering facility.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the release and income statement.
competitive_position.claim: Spending is rising as the programs advance: Q3 R&D was $58.3 million versus $50.5 million a year earlier, mainly from PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO activity and manufacturing for Phase 3 programs. This keeps the pipeline moving but adds to the funding pressure.
quotes: The increase in R&D expenses in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by increased clinical activities related to our active PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO studies and increased manufacturing activities to support our Phase 3 programs.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors; the aflibercept comparator comes from the 8-K.
competitive_position.claim: Competition is named only in general terms. The company says competitors may develop therapeutics or platform technologies that make its candidates or its ABC platform obsolete or less attractive, and aflibercept is the comparator in its studies.
quotes: our competitors may develop therapeutics that render our product candidates obsolete or less attractive;
our competitors may develop platform technologies that render our ABC Platform obsolete or less attractive;

financial_health.basis: Stated in the 10-Q balance sheet (F1) and the earnings release (P8).
financial_health.claim: Liquidity has shrunk sharply. Cash and cash equivalents were 88,678 at Sep. 30, 2026 (table in thousands of dollars), down from 209,862 at Dec. 31, 2025. Current assets of 92,885 cover current liabilities of 54,739.
quotes: Kodiak ended the third quarter of 2026 with $88.7 million of cash and cash equivalents.

financial_health.basis: Read directly from the 10-Q balance sheet (F1). The absence of debt is inferred from the lines shown.
financial_health.claim: Leverage is high relative to equity. Total liabilities of 196,841 (table in thousands) compare with total assets of 209,413 and stockholders' equity of 12,572, down from 157,383 at year-end 2025. Of the liabilities, 100,000 is a liability related to sale of future royalties, and operating lease liabilities are 5,288 current and 41,276 long-term. The balance sheet shows no borrowings line.

financial_health.basis: Stated in the 10-Q cash flow and income statements (F3, F2).
financial_health.claim: The company generates no cash and is burning it faster than a year earlier. Net cash used in operating activities was 130,112 for nine months (table in thousands), against 96,630 a year earlier. The net loss was 190,024. Net cash used in investing activities was 3,274, and the net decrease in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash was 123,423.

financial_health.basis: Read directly from the cash flow statement (F3). The interpretation of the payables effect is inferred.
financial_health.claim: Quality of cash flow is weak. Operating cash use is partly cushioned by non-cash stock-based compensation of 36,563 (table in thousands) and by payables and accruals growing (accounts payable 4,397, accrued liabilities 11,720). The only financing inflow of note was 10,160 from stock option exercises, for net financing of 9,963.

financial_health.basis: Stated in the 10-Q going-concern note and risk factor (P7). The same doubt was stated in the 10-K (P4).
financial_health.claim: The company discloses substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. It says existing cash may not cover the 12 months after the 10-Q filing, and it expects to keep incurring operating losses and negative operating cash flows.
quotes: Our financial condition raises substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.

The Company believes that the existing cash and cash equivalents may not be sufficient to meet the anticipated operating and capital expenditure requirements for the 12 months following the date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.

financial_health.basis: Stated in the earnings release (P8) and 10-Q liquidity text (P7). The absence of maturing debt is inferred from the balance sheet (F1) and the excerpts.
financial_health.claim: Refinancing needs are really equity funding needs. The excerpts show no maturing debt. Management plans to raise additional capital, and after quarter-end it raised $69 million net through its at-the-market equity facility. Shares outstanding rose to 64,306,981 from 61,758,454.
quotes: Subsequent to September 30, 2026, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million through sales of common stock under its ATM equity offering facility.
We plan to raise additional capital to maintain current operations and to continue research and development activities.
We expect that our current cash and cash equivalents will support our current and planned operations into 2027.

growth_thesis.basis: stated in the 8-K release and the 10-Q MD&A
growth_thesis.claim: Zenkuda (tarcocimab) in wet AMD is a growth driver: the DAYBREAK Phase 3 met its primary endpoint (p-value of 0.0007), with 54% of patients on 6-month dosing, and a multi-indication BLA is planned for the fourth quarter of 2026.
quotes: Zenkuda multi-indication biologics license application (BLA) planned for the fourth quarter of 2026 to include five positive Phase 3 studies across wet AMD, diabetic retinopathy and retinal vein occlusion

growth_thesis.claim: For the Zenkuda driver to continue, the BLA must be submitted on time, and the FDA must accept the data package and a dosing label. The company itself flags a possible submission delay and label risk.
quotes: FDA may not approve a label for a particular dosing frequency, even if we believe the data demonstrate support for that dosing.

growth_thesis.basis: stated in the 8-K release; the superiority condition is inferred from the ALTO design description
growth_thesis.claim: Tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) is a second driver: it met the DAYBREAK vision primary endpoint (p-value of 0.0036) and is enrolling the Phase 3 ALTO study in DME. It continues to be a driver only if ALTO shows superiority over aflibercept.
quotes: The ALTO study is now enrolling patients.
Post-hoc analyses to identify which treatment naïve wet AMD patient sub-groups can benefit from IL-6 inhibition are planned.

growth_thesis.claim: KSI-101 in macular edema secondary to inflammation is a near-term catalyst. PEAK Pivotal Analysis 1 topline is on track for December 2026, and a BLA is planned only if results are successful.
quotes: Enrollment of the first 300-patient cohort in the PEAK trial supporting Pivotal Analysis 1 has completed and topline results remain on track for a December 2026 release.

growth_thesis.basis: stated in the cited statements and the release
growth_thesis.claim: Growth depends on continued spending. Nine-month R&D expense rose to 162,934 from 136,880, and net cash used in operating activities was (130,112), all tables in thousands.
quotes: The increase in R&D expenses in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by increased clinical activities related to our active PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO studies and increased manufacturing activities to support our Phase 3 programs.

growth_thesis.basis: stated in the 10-Q, the going concern note and the 8-K release
growth_thesis.claim: A condition for every driver is funding. Cash and cash equivalents were $88.7 million at September 30, 2026. The company reports substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern, and it raised $69 million net after quarter-end through its ATM facility.
quotes: Our financial condition raises substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.
Subsequent to September 30, 2026, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million through sales of common stock under its ATM equity offering facility.

growth_thesis.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A; the dependence on approval is inferred
growth_thesis.claim: Owned commercial-scale manufacturing is a supporting condition. The company says its Ursus facility, built with Lonza, positions it for launch of its ABC products if they are approved.
quotes: We have made significant investments in commercial manufacturing that have positioned us well for potential launch of multiple ABC products into large and growing markets.

growth_thesis.claim: The earlier-stage ABCD platform pipeline (glaucoma and geographic atrophy duet programs) is a longer-dated option, still progressing toward IND.
quotes: Our retina duet programs in glaucoma and GA built with our ABC platform continue to progress towards IND.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited 10-Q passages; the 10-K passage shows the same doubt was already present
material_events.claim: The company's latest quarterly report states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. It reported cash and cash equivalents of $88.7 million at quarter end. The prior annual report carried the same doubt.
quotes: As a result, there is substantial doubt regarding the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.
As of September 30, 2026, we had cash and cash equivalents of $88.7 million.

material_events.claim: After the quarter end, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million from common stock sales under its at-the-market equity offering facility.
quotes: Subsequent to September 30, 2026, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million through sales of common stock under its ATM equity offering facility.

material_events.basis: stated in the 8-K dated September 28, 2026 and repeated in the later earnings release
material_events.claim: Kodiak announced that the primary endpoints were met for both Zenkuda and tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) in the Phase 3 DAYBREAK wet AMD study.
quotes: the primary endpoints were met for both Zenkuda (tarcocimab tedromer) and tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) in the Company’s Phase 3 DAYBREAK study in patients with wet age-related macular degeneration

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q going-concern note and balance and cash-flow statements; the horizon is stated as 'into 2027'.
risks.claim: Cash fell to $88,678 (table in thousands) at Sep 30 from $209,862 at Dec 31, and nine-month operating cash use was $130,112 (table in thousands). The 10-Q states substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern.
quotes: As a result, there is substantial doubt regarding the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

risks.basis: Share counts are from the balance sheet; the dilution language is stated in the 10-Q; the link to the post-quarter raise is inferred.
risks.claim: Funding the burn through equity sales dilutes holders. Shares outstanding rose to 64,306,981 from 61,758,454, and the filing says equity raises will dilute stockholders.
quotes: If we raise additional funds by issuing equity securities, our stockholders will experience dilution.

risks.basis: Figures are from the 10-Q balance sheet; the consequences are inferred.
risks.claim: Balance-sheet cushion is thin. Stockholders' equity fell to 12,572 (table in thousands) from 157,383, against total liabilities of 196,841 that include a 100,000 liability for sale of future royalties.

risks.basis: Stated in the income statement and earnings release; the runway effect is inferred.
risks.claim: Spending is rising. Nine-month R&D was 162,934 (table in thousands) versus 136,880 a year earlier, driven by PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO clinical activity and Phase 3 manufacturing, which increases the funding need.
quotes: The increase in R&D expenses in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by increased clinical activities related to our active PEAK/PINNACLE and ALTO studies and increased manufacturing activities to support our Phase 3 programs.

risks.basis: Risk language is stated in the 10-Q; the DAYBREAK result is stated in the release.
risks.claim: The company has never filed a BLA and plans its first, a multi-indication Zenkuda filing, in the fourth quarter. The filing could be delayed, and the FDA may not accept the AI-guided dosing in labeling.
quotes: We have never submitted a BLA, and even if GLOW1, GLOW2, BEACON, DAYLIGHT or DAYBREAK clinical data support submission of a tarcocimab BLA to the FDA in 2026, we may need to delay submission which would delay review and potential approval.

risks.basis: The timing is stated in the release; the effect of a failure is inferred.
risks.claim: The first KSI-101 Phase 3 (PEAK) readout is expected in December, and a miss would weaken one of the three late-stage assets. The company cites past late-stage setbacks as a risk.
quotes: topline results remain on track for a December 2026 release
Many companies in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries have suffered significant setbacks in late-stage clinical studies after achieving positive results in previous clinical studies

risks.basis: The post-hoc plan is stated in the release; reading it as an unresolved differentiation question is inferred.
risks.claim: The bispecific IL-6 thesis for tabirafusp-ted (KSI-501) in wet AMD is not yet clearly differentiated. The company plans post-hoc analyses to find which sub-groups benefit from IL-6 inhibition, while the ALTO study tests superiority in DME.
quotes: Post-hoc analyses to identify which treatment naïve wet AMD patient sub-groups can benefit from IL-6 inhibition are planned.

quotes: Our financial condition raises substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern.
Subsequent to September 30, 2026, Kodiak raised aggregate net proceeds of $69 million through sales of common stock under its ATM equity offering facility.

We have never submitted a BLA, and even if GLOW1, GLOW2, BEACON, DAYLIGHT or DAYBREAK clinical data support submission of a tarcocimab BLA to the FDA in 2026, we may need to delay submission which would delay review and potential approval.
